noeuds.role: Runs automatically, only once, as soon as the scene is loaded on screen.
noeuds.exemple: place enemies at their starting position, or set the player's health to 100.

noeuds.role: Runs continuously, at every screen refresh.
noeuds.exemple: spin an object forever, or update a score.

noeuds.role: Triggers when the player's finger touches the targeted object.
noeuds.exemple: open a chest, press a button, or start a dialogue.

noeuds.role: Triggers when the player lifts their finger from the screen, anywhere.
noeuds.exemple: stop shooting when the finger is lifted.

noeuds.role: Trigger when the player starts dragging a draggable object, and when they drop it.
noeuds.exemple: drop a key on a door to open it.

noeuds.role: Triggers at the exact moment object A physically touches object B.
noeuds.exemple: when "Player" touches "Coin" → play a sound and destroy the coin.

noeuds.role: Triggers when the targeted object collides with any object carrying the given label (Tag).
noeuds.exemple: when "Missile" touches an object tagged "Enemy" → explosion.

noeuds.role: Activates when an object enters or leaves a defined zone (ideal for invisible triggers).
noeuds.exemple: the player walks into the "Trap" zone → spikes come out of the ground.

noeuds.role: Handles a finger or pointer passing over an object, without needing to click.
noeuds.exemple: highlight a button when passing over it.

noeuds.role: Detects when the object bounces or hits something solid with gravity enabled.
noeuds.exemple: play a pebble sound when the stone falls to the ground.

noeuds.role: Constantly watches a variable. As soon as its value changes, this node runs what follows.
noeuds.exemple: if health changes, update the visual health bar.

noeuds.role: A custom event you can trigger from elsewhere with the "Call Local Event" node.
noeuds.exemple: group the "Game Over" logic so you can call it from several places.

noeuds.role: Triggers specifically when the interface's virtual "ACTION" button is pressed.
noeuds.exemple: talk to an NPC or read a sign in front of you.
